name: Composite Depth Cueing and Directional Shading
definition: A composite shading model combining linear attenuation (depth cueing) and hemispherical illumination. It requires 16 precomputed spectra and is slower than individual models due to a high constant factor, though asymptotically less expensive than conventional rendering.
summary: Composite Depth Cueing and Directional Shading is a frequency-domain technique that simultaneously applies linear depth cueing and hemispherical directional shading to volume data, avoiding nonlinear operators by factoring lighting direction out of the integral.
